csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor; using UnityEngine.SceneManagement; public class Script { public static void Main() { var scene = SceneManager.GetActiveScene(); Debug.Log($"Active Scene: {scene.name}"); var roots = scene.GetRootGameObjects(); foreach (var root in roots) { Debug.Log(root.name); var comps = root.GetComponentsInChildren<MonoBehaviour>(true); foreach(var c in comps) { if (c.GetType().Name.Contains("Task") || c.GetType().Name.Contains("Quest") || c.GetType().Name.Contains("Objective")) { Debug.Log($"Found quest script {c.GetType().Name} on {c.gameObject.name}"); } } } } }
